title: Sketch ink
description: Hand-drawn stroke engine shared by the sketch assets. stroke(g, points, { width, color, style: ink|pen|pencil|marker, progress, wobble, boil, seed }) draws a wobbly, pressure-tapered ribbon and returns the pen tip; strokes(g, list, o) draws several in sequence with pen lifts. Shape helpers (line, arc, circle, bez, spline, rect, arrow, hatch, scribble, fit, path), boil(g, fps) for the hand-drawn "boil", and pencil(g, tip) draws a pencil cursor at the tip. Version 2 adds roundBox (a rounded box as one closed outline), tick (a check mark) and card(g, x, y, w, h, { progress, fill, color, shadow }) for a hand-drawn card with a hard offset shadow that draws on.
